Written by the scheduled runs (Monday shopcardhub-weekly-trend-scan + Tuesday bowman-bangers-tuesday-update + Thursday comc-trader) as part of their normal repo edits; deployed by Vercel like calls.json. The dungeon reads this client-side and renders REAL pipeline state alongside the sim. SCHEMA: agents{key:{label,role,lastRun,nextRun,actions[{ts,msg}]}} — keys are dm|seeker|curator|inspector|gengar|trader (first five map to sprites; trader added Aug 19, feed-only; append newest action LAST, keep ~12 max per agent). TRADER REDACTION RULE: trader actions must NEVER contain card names, prices, quantities, costs, or budget figures — counts, lanes, hit rates and lessons only; this file is public and the trader's book is not. items[{slug,title,stage,note,ts}] — stage enum: discovered (on the radar, no work yet) | proposed (new-page idea awaiting Mo) | scaffolded (draft stub exists) | built (page built locally, unpushed) | live (deployed) | skipped (with reason). Keep live to the ~8 most recent; prune stale discovered/proposed when resolved. proposals[{id,area,summary,status}] — status: awaiting-mo | approved | applied | declined. scoreboard mirrors data/calls.json rollup. Update 'generated' every write.

FIXED Aug 25: api/comps.js accepts ?customid=, sanitizes it to [a-z0-9._-] max 64 (which also strips ',' and CRLF, making it safe to interpolate into X-EBAY-C-ENDUSERCTX), and appends affiliateReferenceId=<id> to the affiliate header.
